text: We evaluated a multi-stage weak-to-strong pipeline on the chat_preference testbed, combining CCS-guided confidence resampling with an SGD warmup phase and then evolution-strategy LoRA refinement that uses swap-consistency as its fitness signal. Across 16 seeds, the measured performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.93. That figure is the only outcome quantity available for this run, and it should be read with several caveats. No baseline PGR was supplied alongside these metrics, so we cannot characterize the result as an improvement over a reference method, nor can we say how much of the recovered gap is attributable to the evolution-strategy stage as opposed to the resampling or warmup components. The metrics also omit any dispersion estimate — no standard deviation or standard error across the 16 seeds — so the precision of the 0.93 point estimate is unknown, and seed-level variability cannot be bounded. Reporting per-seed values, an ablation over the three stages, and a matched baseline would be needed before drawing comparative conclusions.
